title: 971. Smallest String Starting From Leaf

examples.explanation: Leaf-to-root strings include dba, eba and others; dba is the smallest.
The covering leaf strings are compared; adz is minimal.
Only a few root paths exist and abc is the smallest leaf-up spelling.
